markets.authority: Hong Kong Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau
markets.review: Hong Kong states that it has no value-added or sales tax. This is an explicit software checkout exemption candidate, not a missing-rate fallback and not evidence of merchant registration.

Qatar's tax authority states that Qatar has not applied VAT. This is an explicit software checkout exemption candidate, not a missing-rate fallback, and must be reviewed again before activation because the GCC framework could later be implemented.

Article 5(23) of Law 48/2024/QH15, effective 1 July 2025, places software products and software services under the applicable information-technology and digital-industry law outside VAT. This is an explicit software VAT exemption candidate, not a missing-rate fallback, and it does not determine separate corporate-income tax or foreign-supplier filing obligations.
